name: Ootsu Kenji
source:
A classmate of Yuuta's. He is indecisive and withdrawn and is pushed around by Yuuta in any way.

Even now, three years later, that hasn't changed.

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/yara_syuugaku/chara.html]official site[/url]]
